quotes.text: You can't trust code that you did not totally create yourself.
quotes.author: Ken Thompson
quotes.source: Reflections on Trusting Trust, 1984 Turing Award Lecture

quotes.text: SOC 2 compliance is proof that you filled out a lot of paperwork, not proof that you're secure.

quotes.text: The best time to learn about security is before you get hacked. The second best time is after. The worst time is never.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The best security practice is assuming you've already been breached.

quotes.text: Every new dependency is a potential vulnerability. Audit them like you audit your employees.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The best time to think about security is before you ship. The second best time is after you've been breached.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The most dangerous thing in the world is a programmer who thinks they understand security.

quotes.text: We'll have to start treating the CPR number as just a username, instead of a password. It should never have been "secret" in the first place.
quotes.author: madsohm
quotes.source: Hacker News — Denmark Data Breach Exposes 8.8M People's Personal Data
quotes.extraction_note: Universal security insight — identifiers aren't secrets. Works far beyond Denmark and is exactly the kind of unglamorous pragmatic wisdom this API wants.

quotes.text: Port 5900 open to the WAN. He wrote an article to tell the world that he doesn't understand basic networking.
quotes.author: 7r33
quotes.source: Hacker News — Apple and a Hacker's Future
quotes.extraction_note: Beautiful short-form dev burn: setup + punchline in one line. Cleaned the original typo ('Having 5900 hot to wan') so the joke actually lands without the reader needing to decode it.
